meta.model_ref: models are referred to by their index in 'models'

columns.recent: kickoff_utc, home, away, home_goals, away_goals, tips (per recent.models: [home, away, points(, 1 = backfill)] or null)

rules.scoring: Kicktipp four points on the score after 90 minutes: 4 exact result, 3 correct goal difference, 2 correct tendency (a draw with the wrong score is 2), 0 otherwise
rules.pick: Per fixture and model the latest prediction made before kickoff; a rescheduled fixture counts once, with the kickoff of its newest record
rules.offered: A finished fixture is offered to a model from its first prediction to the last kickoff it predicted; a missing tip scores 0. avg0 = points per offered fixture (ranking key), avg = points per tip, se = standard error of avg0, ci = avg0 +- 1.96 se, ppmd = points per matchday
rules.hit_types: Exclusive: exact = 4, diff = 3, tendency = 2, wrong = 0 points with a tip, missed = no tip; shares are of offered fixtures
rules.baselines: Odds-Favourite (Favourite 2:1): 2:1 home / 1:2 away favourite by margin-free win probability of the latest odds before kickoff (never a draw; no odds = no tip). Always-2:1. Consensus: median of every model's tip per side, .5 rounded up, at least two tips. Baselines are offered every fixture
rules.matchdays: Per league a new matchday starts when a team plays again or after a break of more than 3 days
rules.timeline: Cumulative points per step: matchdays (one season, one league), ISO weeks (one season, all leagues) or months (all seasons), Europe/Berlin; points[model] = [index of its first step, cumulative points up to its last step with an offered fixture]
rules.form: [avg0, points, offered] over the last 5 matchdays (one league) or ISO weeks (all leagues)
rules.fair: Leaderboard on the fixtures offered to every active model (missing tips score 0); 'established' leaves out late joiners
rules.reliability: Live predictions only: run_tipped of run_offered fixtures listed in the runs while the model was active (missed_runs = runs without any tip); delivered of expected finished fixtures with a tip before kickoff
rules.backfill: Backfill tips (generated later for a late-joining model) count by default; 'backfill' counts them, 'live' rows score without them
